title: Classic Italian Pasta Bowl
description: A simple yet satisfying Italian-inspired pasta dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Quick to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to release their juices, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped basil and cook for an additional minute.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce.
Toss the pasta to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta in individual bowls and top with parmesan cheese.
